environment: Linux (pose extraction unavailable; canonical runs absent — replay suites skip; all fixtures synthetic, clearly labeled)
method: Fixture-driven adversarial probing of proposeStrokeEventsV2 / selectTargetEvent(V2) (packages/swing-lab/src/strokeEvents.ts) and SessionEventEngine (packages/analysis-pipeline/src/sessionEngine.ts) with synthetic gaussian speed-bump series: rapid consecutive strokes (400–1000ms peak gaps), practice+real swing, miss (full swing, no/orphaned contact), interrupted swing, walk-through wrist wobble, late-sample injection.

breaks.title: Rapid consecutive strokes glued into ONE event
breaks.detail: Two comparable strokes with peaks 600–700ms apart were fused by the v2 fragment glue into a single event spanning both swings (e.g. gap=700: one event [1280,2440] with the second stroke's peak erased) — fabricated multi-swing bounds; downstream would analyze a two-stroke window as one. The streaming engine (frontier-incremental) emitted TWO events for the same series, silently diverging from the batch proposer.
breaks.fix: GLUE_GATES distinct-stroke guard: a later fragment whose peak is ≥550ms from the previous fragment's peak AND ≥0.6× its peak speed is a distinct stroke — never glued. Applied identically in the canonical proposer and its byte-identical mirror.
breaks.coverageDelta: Committed positive golds unchanged: all 19 pre-existing swing-lab suites (231 passed / 4 skipped) and 5 analysis-pipeline suites (34 passed) green before and after; the measured rally1 fragmentation shape (swing + weaker follow-through burst, peaks ≈480ms apart) is regression-pinned as still glued. Canonical rally replay suites skip on this host (data absent) — cascade numbers NOT re-measured, none claimed.

breaks.title: Orphaned contact estimate silently steered selection
breaks.detail: selectTargetEvent with a contact estimate OUTSIDE every proposed event (±60ms) — the miss / wrong-contact case — fell through to prominence selection with no recorded signal; the return was indistinguishable from a clean prominence selection, so a contact claim from a miss could be attached downstream to an event it does not belong to (the code comment said 'callers should treat this as suspicious' but nothing was recorded).
breaks.fix: Additive `contactOrphaned?: true` field on the selected variant of TargetEventSelection (set on prominence fall-through and on the V2 paddle_confirmation tie-break when the anchor is outside all events). No existing field or semantics changed — usable-result-v1 / silent-failure-v1 contracts untouched.
breaks.coverageDelta: Zero: flag is additive; all pre-existing selection behavior byte-identical (full suites green).

breaks.title: Walk-through wobble fabricated a 4.2s mega-event
breaks.detail: Sustained locomotion wobble (0.45–0.75 u/s, no stroke) chained through the ≤350ms fragment glue into a single 4240ms 'event' [3200,7440] — far beyond the ±1200ms boundary-reach cap of any single movement.
breaks.fix: Same GLUE_GATES guard as B1 breaks the chain: wobble fragments are comparably strong with far-apart peaks, so they stay separate (each ≤2400ms).
breaks.residualOpen: Locomotion still yields low-confidence (~0.45) short proposals; selection abstains on them (MULTI_STROKE_AMBIGUOUS, no decisive prominence leader — regression-pinned). Suppressing them outright would be a blanket-abstention risk to positive gold coverage that cannot be measured on this host (canonical runs absent) — left OPEN deliberately.

breaks.title: KNOWN LIMIT: comparable strokes ≤500ms apart remain glued
breaks.detail: Two comparable strokes with peaks ≤500ms apart are indistinguishable from the MEASURED rally1 single-movement fragmentation (fragments 167ms apart, peaks ≈480ms apart) using wrist-speed shape alone; lowering the 550ms guard would un-glue real fragmented single strokes. Regression-pinned as a documented limit; needs real rapid-exchange dev labels (34-event corpus) to move.

testedNoBreak: Practice swing + real swing: comparable proposals abstain MULTI_STROKE_AMBIGUOUS without an anchor; a contact anchor inside the real swing selects it (never the practice swing).
Miss (full swing, no contact estimate): proposals carry no contact field; selection with null contact makes no contact claim.
Interrupted swing: micro-burst under minEventSpanMs (160ms) proposes nothing; a short burst gets bounds confined to the observed motion.
Single-frame wrist spike: smoothed away, no event.

Closed-event immutability: late samples behind the frontier dropped + counted (droppedLateSamples), closed bounds byte-identical after adversarial late spike injection, emitted proposals Object.frozen, rapid-stroke emissions non-overlapping.
